purpose: Declares the lab's rule postures so that 'which rules is this run using' is an explicit, verifiable object rather than an implicit code path. Each profile pairs a consensus rule set (monetary / PoW / coinbase, faithful to a source edition) with a script-vocabulary posture. NOT money.
invariant: A 'nothing-disabled' posture re-opens the one functional opcode v0.1 disabled (OP_NOTEQUAL); it is safe ONLY because the isolated experimental networks carry no value. A 'faithful-v0.1' posture reproduces v0.1's EvalScript as written, with OP_NOTEQUAL disabled.

faithful-v0.1.source_witness: script.cpp:486 (case commented out); reason at script.cpp:494

nothing-disabled.realized_as: OP_EQUAL then OP_NOT (both native to v0.1); no new behavior invented

profiles.name: jan09-faithful
profiles.description: The released v0.1.0 client as written: January consensus parameters over the v0.1 script vocabulary with OP_NOTEQUAL disabled.

profiles.name: jan09-x
profiles.description: The isolated JAN09-X experimental network: January consensus with the full vocabulary, OP_NOTEQUAL re-opened. Safe only because it is not money.

profiles.name: nov08-source-bounded
profiles.description: The November 2008 pre-release constitution (its monetary / PoW / coinbase rules) over the v0.1-derived script substrate the preview itself lacks, OP_NOTEQUAL disabled.

profiles.name: nov08-x
profiles.description: The isolated NOV08-X experimental network: November constitution with the full vocabulary, OP_NOTEQUAL re-opened. Safe only because it is not money.
